scope: Exclusive fractions use the rank with the largest parent wall time; phase maxima are separate diagnostics and never summed. Numeric measure sums are rank work, not elapsed time. Engine work imbalance uses active workers only. Process CPU includes MPI progress; elapsed minus CPU is not MPI wait. The native wait phase is subset completion only. For M<N, active_worker_exclusive is a separately closed worker row; inactive subset waiting can dominate the global critical row. Tracked bytes include self traffic and omit direct/vendor communication. New wrapper totals close import+parent+worker; nested bridge/engine details are subsets and are not added again. Tracked collectives measure wrapper calls and elapsed packing/progress time, not all MPI calls or pure waiting. Historical bytes-only rows remain legacy coverage. Directory elections are API calls, not MPI-call counts. RSS is a process lifetime high-water mark. Different stages/events remain separate; event_index is the within-stage log ordinal, not a shared cycle identifier.
